summary: Across 5 experiments and 16.5 minutes, 3 experiments were compute-bound. Qwen3.6 one-family flagship source shard was the slowest at the reported 15-minute resolution; the other 4 entries were reported at 0-minute resolution.

slowest_experiments.experiment: V572 terminal recovery and decomposed flagship contract
V572 SOTA source and joint-proof method protocol

bottlenecks_identified: Qwen3.6 one-family flagship source shard formed the 15-minute compute critical path, but no data available this milestone identifies which execution phase caused that duration.
The other 4 entries are reported at 0-minute resolution, preventing useful phase or task-duration comparison below one minute.
The GPU report is a point sample without experiment-window linkage or readiness information, so it cannot show whether the unused device had an independent task available to run.
improvements_suggested: Add task-linked start, stop, and phase clocks plus periodic GPU utilization samples for every compute-bound experiment.
Benchmark configurable batches of 8-16 compatible questions per forward pass and retain batching only when milestone-local timings improve.
Add a free-device scheduler that launches a second ready, independent single-model job on GPU 0 while keeping each single GGUF task on one GPU.
Emit loaded-model count, device assignment, and runner-selection receipts at launch so DualGPURunner is selected and auditable only when 2 or more models are loaded in parallel.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Benchmark 8-16-question inference batches with before-and-after task timings.
Schedule a second ready, independent single-model job on the free GPU.
Join phase clocks and GPU samples to each task and record model-count and runner-selection receipts.
meta_reflection: GPU 1 was active at 94% utilization while GPU 0 was unused, which shows spare device capacity but not a compute-idle defect for a single-model task. No data available this milestone establishes a compute task with 2 or more models loaded in parallel, so a missed DualGPURunner engagement cannot be identified; the 0% savings estimate reflects the absence of a measured counterfactual.
